theme_strategy: Dual-theme (Light/Dark) modern 2026 SaaS aesthetic. Transitioning from heavy Brutalism to 'Optical Clarity' and precision (Vercel/Linear style). Retaining the core Red/Black identity as the hero signature.

colors.semantic: Demote the existing vibrant blue/yellow to pure semantic states (info/warning) to maintain a calm, premium 'ink/paper/red' dominance.

typography.rationale: Geist Sans (or Satoshi) provides the razor-sharp 2026 tech aesthetic required for the upgrade, stripping away the heavy 'chunkiness' of Chivo. Retaining IBM Plex Mono for technical/data/OS outputs maintains the established 'DecisionOS brain' character.

elevation_and_depth.brutalism_replacement: Completely remove 'shadow-brutal' (hard black offsets). Move to 'layered subtle depth'.
elevation_and_depth.light_mode: Use hairline borders (`border-border`) combined with incredibly subtle layered shadows (`shadow-sm` or custom `shadow-[0_2px_8px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]`).
elevation_and_depth.dark_mode: Zero outer drop shadows. Rely entirely on 1px borders (`border-white/10` or `border-border`) and subtle inner highlights (`shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.05)]`) to create crisp depth without mud.
elevation_and_depth.glassmorphism: Use heavily saturated glass for sticky headers/nav overlays: `bg-background/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border`. NEVER use a fully transparent background.

radii_and_spacing.radius: Move from `rounded-none` to `rounded-lg` (8px) and `rounded-xl` (12px) to soften the aggressive edge while staying precise. Buttons: `rounded-md`. Cards: `rounded-xl`.
radii_and_spacing.density: High density for Data/Dashboard sections. Use `gap-4` or `gap-6` between bento grid items. Internal card padding must be at least `p-6` to avoid cramped data. Use 'The Bento Grid Protocol'.

component_treatments.sidebar_nav_shell: Solid muted background (`bg-muted/30` or `bg-zinc-950`). Active menu items should have a subtle red left-border indicator (`border-l-2 border-primary`) with an extremely subtle red background tint.
component_treatments.cards: Remove brutalist boxes. Use `bg-card border border-border rounded-xl`. Focus on the 'Grid Borders' concept where adjacent cards align beautifully with consistent 1px borders.

buttons.primary: Solid `#FF3B30` (`bg-primary`), white text. On hover, do NOT lighten color; instead use an interaction lift: `hover:-translate-y-[1px] transition-transform` and `active:scale-[0.98]`.
buttons.secondary: Outline or soft fill. `bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground border border-border`. Hover: `bg-secondary/80`.

component_treatments.inputs: Flat surfaces. `bg-background border border-input rounded-md`. Focus state MUST use the brand red ring: `focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:border-primary`.
component_treatments.chips_badges: Use `IBM Plex Mono` for text. Light background tint with solid border (e.g., `bg-primary/10 text-primary border border-primary/20` for red tags).
component_treatments.tables: Edge-to-edge inside a rounded-xl container. `border-b border-border` on rows. Hover: `bg-muted/50`. Align numeric metrics to the right.

motion_and_interactions.tactile_clicks: Add `active:scale-[0.98]` to all buttons and actionable cards for a premium tactile feel.
motion_and_interactions.color_fades: Fade background colors smoothly using `transition-colors duration-200`.
motion_and_interactions.entrances: Staggered fade-up for feed items/dashboard cards (e.g., `opacity-0 translate-y-2` fading into `opacity-100 translate-y-0`).

tailwind_config_tokens.theme_extend_snippet: colors: { brand: { red: '#FF3B30', ink: '#0A0A0B', paper: '#F4F4F5' } }, fontFamily: { sans: ['Geist Sans', 'Satoshi', 'sans-serif'], mono: ['IBM Plex Mono', 'monospace'] }, boxShadow: { subtle: '0 2px 8px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)', 'glass-dark': 'inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05)' }

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: You are working with `.js` files, not `.tsx`. Do not include TypeScript types or interfaces.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="decision-desk-submit"`).
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in headers, dropdowns, overlays, or any surface over content. Always use solid colors or glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80`).
Replace ALL old brutalist classes (`shadow-brutal`, `rounded-none`, `label-mono`, `card-brutal`) with the new precise 2026 tokens.
Apply 'Optical Alignment' - adjust padding slightly if icons make text look misaligned inside buttons or lists.
Use Phosphor icons consistently to match the premium tech aesthetic.
